notes.title: Demo Update V55 - More Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[p][b]V55 - More Bug Fixes![/b] [/p][list][*][p]Graffiti can no longer spawn behind wall furniture. [/p][/*][*][p]No more floating furniture (At least when aiming at the ground..) [/p][/*][*][p]Furniture collides again and can no longer be free-form built. [/p][/*][*][p]Default poster for Visit Venus (which has a duplicate to the right) has been replaced on new saves. [/p][/*][*][p]12 Angry Clones poster doesn't replace the Kawaii poster on reload anymore. [/p][/*][*][p]Galactic Cola poster shouldn't rotate itself. Teleporter once again takes carts. [/p][/*][*][p]Voice Lines from tutorial no longer play while paused. [/p][/*][*][p]Our Bad Initiative poster typos are corrected. [/p][/*][*][p]Customer voice lines at checkout won't be backwards. [/p][/*][*][p]Many items / furniture pieces from the station have their entire mesh highlighted correctly now. [/p][/*][*][p]It's really easy to destroy placed items near the checkout kiosk now. [/p][/*][*][p]Store level 3 geometry reworked a bit. [/p][/*][*][p]We're still tweaking a bit the world itself. [/p][/*][*][p]Popup text on pause menu now disappears appropriately. [/p][/*][*][p]Hydroponics flow has been cleaned up. [/p][/*][*][p]You can go from slice to bag, or bag to slice. [/p][/*][*][p]Hydroponics table now allows placement of bananas or slices directly on the table alongside a correct outline. [/p][/*][*][p]Hydroponics table also has a better 'bag placement' tooltip/outline. Watering can graphics redone. Cart physics changed.. again. [/p][/*][*][p]Customers can now be interacted with by pressing 'E'. [/p][/*][*][p]More localilzation. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Couple of quick notes on things we're working on over the weekend [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial Priority (Speedrunning / overlapping dialogue correction) - High priority. [/p][/*][*][p]Needing to double-stay to proceed with blackjack if playing with customers. [/p][/*][*][p]Narrator dialogue/tutorial dialogue will have seperate sliders. [/p][/*][*][p]The new graffiti graphics make it hard to tell when an area is 'cleaned'.. we're correcting that. [/p][/*][*][p]We're gonna allow you to build in some more areas that are seemingly restricted without a good reason (Hydroponics circle area, on top of doorways) [/p][/*][*][p]Making our way thru the 'selected to dev' suggestions as well. New Content: Employees![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to @SilverLotus , @ByteMe / BBSmalls , @Lux and everyone for contributing and adding suggestions/detailed bug reports. 

Ya'll are awesome <3[/p][/*][/list]
